public_lists.name: Library News & History
public_lists.description: What's new in Medora and what's turning up in the collection. Exhibition openings, building news, and stories from the diaries, letters, and objects T.R. left behind. The one list to pick if picking only one.

public_lists.name: Events & Programs
public_lists.description: Talks, family days, festivals, and evening programs on the butte. Sent far enough ahead that seats are still open when the email lands.

public_lists.name: From the Archive
public_lists.description: One story a month, pulled straight from the collection: a page of T.R.'s diary, a letter home from the Badlands, an object with a history worth telling. Sourced and cited every time.

public_lists.name: The Badlands
public_lists.description: Bison in the snow, first bloom on the prairie, first light on the buttes. A monthly look at the landscape that shaped T.R. — and at the native prairie being restored across the Library's 93 acres.

public_lists.name: Conservation & Sustainability
public_lists.description: How the building works and what the land is doing. The Four Zeros in practice — energy, water, emissions, waste — plus the Native Plant Project and the conservation programming built around it.

public_lists.name: Salt+Scoria
public_lists.description: Seasonal menus, special dinners, and reservation windows at the Library's restaurant, where the food is rooted in the Northern Plains and the ingredients are named for a reason.

public_lists.name: The Shop
public_lists.description: New arrivals, seasonal sales, and small-batch goods from the Library's store — books, Badlands gear, and objects drawn from the collection.

public_lists.name: Educators & Homeschool
public_lists.description: Classroom-ready primary sources, field trip booking windows, and professional development, timed to the school calendar rather than the marketing one. Five or six emails a year.

public_lists.name: Press & Media
public_lists.description: Releases, advisories, and asset drops for credentialed journalists. Not a marketing list — no appeals, no promotions, no event invitations.
